u6: What room is it? We sing and play instruments here.
Phòng âm nhạc là nơi chúng ta ca hát và chơi nhạc cụ.
Choose the correct word: P _ _ _ r o o m (phòng học)
Từ đúng là classroom, nghĩa là phòng học.
Complete the sentence: ___ go to the art room.
Cấu trúc rủ ai đó cùng làm gì là Let's cộng với động từ nguyên mẫu.
Which room is used for painting and drawing?
Art room la phong my thuat, noi hoc sinh ve tranh va to mau.
Choose the correct spelling for 'phong am nhac' in English.
Music room la tu dung chinh ta de chi phong am nhac.
What do you do in the computer room?
Trong phong may tinh (computer room), hoc sinh su dung may tinh.
Complete the sentence: "Is this your classroom?" – "Yes, ___."
Cau hoi bat dau bang "Is this..." thi cau tra loi khang dinh dung la "Yes, it is".
playground la danh tu (san choi), con lai la tinh tu chi dac diem.
Choose the correct word to fill in the blank: "Let's ___ to the library."
Cau de nghi "Let's" di voi dong tu nguyen mau khong to, vay chon "go".
Computer room co nghia la phong may tinh.
Look at the sentence: "Our school is old, but it is nice." What is the school like?
Cau van neu ro truong cu (old) nhung dep (nice).
Rearrange the words to make a correct sentence: room / is / This / computer / a
Cau hoan chinh dung ngu phap la "This is a computer room".
Choose the correct question for the answer: "Yes, it is a big library."
Cau tra loi "Yes, it is..." ung voi cau hoi bat dau bang "Is it...".
What is the opposite of 'small' for a classroom?
Tu trai nghia voi "small" (nho) la "big" (to, lon).
Computer la tu viet dung chinh ta chi may tinh.
Fill in the blank: "Is the school big?" – "No, it ___."
Cau hoi "Is..." va tra loi "No" thi dung dang phu dinh la "isn't".
Which word completes the phrase: "a ___ playground" (san choi dep)
Tinh tu "nice" dung de mo ta mot san choi dep.
Read and match: We sing songs in the ___.
Noi chung ta hat ca la phong am nhac (music room).
Identify the mistake in the sentence: "Let go to the gym."
Cau de nghi phai la "Let's" (Let us), tu "Let" trong cau nay bi thieu dau nhay va chu s.
Thu vien (library) la noi co rat nhieu sach.
